by_design_evidence_note: The v3.4-tightened explicitness standard is met by convergent deliberate declarations rather than a single 'by design' comment: (1) the hand-written Default impl for VectorsConfig (types.rs:1475-1479) makes Multi(empty) the canonical default state of a new collection; (2) the named constructor VectorsConfig::empty() exists expressly for that state; (3) #[serde(default)] on the vectors field is an intentional attribute making omission legal; (4) the struct doc-comment at types.rs:1455-1467 is the verbatim source of the api-reference page text, and the Fern-generated page renders the field as Optional; (5) the maintainer comment at collection_meta_ops.rs:197-198 explicitly references the PUT /collections/{name}/vectors/{vector_name} creation path, i.e. named vector params are designed to be addable after collection creation. No contradicting 'must reject empty' check exists anywhere on the create path.
